fn idle() ->
    recv
        _msg -> idle()

pid = spawn(() -> idle())
register(:worker, pid)
info(pid)
info(1)
Repl.info(:nope)
watched = spawn_watched(() -> ())
dead = watched[0]
ref = watched[1]
recv
    (:down, r, _) when r == ref -> ()
info(dead)
-- output --
pid = #<pid 1>
Ok(())
